question: Should this PR become the canonical landing branch for the dead-export stabilization, or should the focused work land through https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/105945 or the broader cleanup in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/105867?
rationale: The current PR has protected maintainer handling, a dirty merge state, and two viable overlapping branches; automation cannot safely select the canonical scope or resolve which comparison-only changes should survive.

options.title: Rebase and narrow this PR
options.body: Use this editable branch as canonical, rebase it onto current main, and retain only the focused Knip and private-export changes that remain unique.

options.title: Land the focused predecessor
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/105945 for the stabilization if its branch can be maintained, then remove duplicate changes from this PR.

options.title: Fold into the broad cleanup
options.body: Carry the stabilization only in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/105867 if maintainers want one coordinated dead-export contract audit and landing event.

recommendation.title: Rebase and narrow this PR
recommendation.body: Use this editable branch as canonical, rebase it onto current main, and retain only the focused Knip and private-export changes that remain unique.

likelyOwner.reason: This person authored the overlapping stabilization commit and has coordinated the related ratchet and dead-export branches in the supplied discussion.
